coder_notes: Basket design. Only the Phase 1 and Phase 2b NEO212-alone cohorts include glioma (IDH-mutant astrocytoma and IDH-wildtype GBM, recurrent). All partner drugs (ipilimumab, pembrolizumab, nivolumab, regorafenib, carboplatin, paclitaxel, FOLFIRI, bevacizumab) are given 'per package insert' as standard of care in brain-metastasis arms only, so coded soc_backbone. PD-L1, EGFR/ALK and MSI-H/dMMR criteria apply to non-GBM brain-metastasis arms and relate to SOC partner drugs, not to NEO212. NEO212 conjugates temozolomide (an established GBM therapy) with perillyl alcohol; flagged for adjudication of candidate status and formulation_flag. Lead sponsor is a company (Neonc Technologies).
